notes: *it is impossible* is `added` under rule 37, its Greek Ἀδύνατον standing at HEB.6.4 and left `unrepresented` there. This is a versification difference between the projection and the ASV, not a Greek idiom.
*afresh* is kept with ἀνασταυροῦντας, realizing the ἀνα- of the compound, rather than with πάλιν, which already has its own *again*.

The italicized *then* is folded onto καί as *and then* under rules 7 and 11. Placing it instead on παραπεσόντας as a rule 86 participle helper is the competing reading; the status is `aligned` either way.
παραδειγματίζοντας → *put him to an open shame* heads on *shame* under rule 17, *put* carrying no sense of its own.
